title: Building Search
summary: Searching a building for a suspect, such as after an alarm with signs of entry.

steps.text: Set a perimeter covering all exits
Get the layout and keyholder information if possible
Request K-9; give a loud K-9 or police announcement and wait
Team of at least two; agree on a plan and radio channel
Move slowly using cover; clear corners by slicing the pie
Clear one room at a time; check closets, ceilings, under furniture
Mark or call out cleared areas
Keep one officer covering while another searches
Document point of entry, damage and evidence
Notify the owner or keyholder and secure the building

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
